Everything above about "The Price is Right™" comes from the Texas Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
2774.headline: No top prize claimed lately

2775.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "Casino 7s", most are still unsold. The game is still new, with four of four top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

If "Casino 7s" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
2775.headline: Early stage or late

2776.body:
The most common win left on "Patriotic Payout" is $2. The second biggest prize left is $500, and 124 of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

If you play "Patriotic Payout" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2776.headline: A close look at the prizes
